T14-selected-not-checked.note: The 'is not selected' half of A46. Guards the 2026-08-13 widening of T14's matcher: it keyed on 'checked' only, so following A46's own advice (switch to mozVerifyElementIsSelected) produced a message the rule could not see. Keep both state words in the regex.
